answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because prism only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, ridge is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any nectar approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
